brief: Verify Netlify resilience, evaluate the completed A1.1 course, and implement remaining safe remediation

goals.title: Netlify resilience
goals.objective: Reproduce the historical Supabase timeout path against current code, harden deterministic deployment if needed, and prove the build succeeds offline
goals.evidence: Forced local Supabase 504 produced two retries, emergency cache activation, and a successful 130-page Astro build; cache-first build also completed 130 pages; targeted release tests 6/6 pass; npm ci lock warning traced to and resolved by explicit @types/ms metadata.

goals.title: A1.1 deterministic quality
goals.objective: Inspect the completed course artifacts and run structural, content, coverage, and regression checks
goals.evidence: 347/347 focused A1.1 tests pass; validate-curriculum a1.1 and duplicate-sync checks exit 0; independently measured 12 lessons, 49 can-dos, 263 Wortfeld entries, 120 dialogue lines, 378 controlled-practice items, 12 writing tasks, 12 speaking tasks, 4 checkpoints; audio manifest is empty and final test is explicitly a shortened 40-minute Start Deutsch 1-style test without an in-test speaking section.

goals.title: A1.1 learner experience
goals.objective: Render and exercise representative A1.1 journeys on desktop and mobile, recording usability and teaching-quality findings
goals.evidence: Rendered production build at 390x844 and desktop. Completed representative A1.1 lesson 1 end-to-end through pretest, dialogue/translation, Wortfeld, grammar notice, 7-item controlled practice, dictation, speaking, writing, remediation, recap, and guest progress persistence; browser console had 0 warnings/errors. Found two actionable UX/integrity defects: FloatingIntroButton overlaps mobile lesson controls and direct URL access bypasses visual checkpoint locking.

goals.title: Final remediation and verification
goals.objective: Implement remaining in-scope code fixes, run the full verification suite, and leave a clean review-ready branch
goals.evidence: Netlify-cache Astro build completed 130 pages; Vite production build completed; 138 built HTML pages passed with 0 failures and warnings; lint and duplicate sync passed; mobile renderer verified course lesson, locked checkpoint redirect, 40-minute final test, no floating intro and no console errors; independent A1.1 evaluation report written.
